name: Scared Fearless
source:
Scared Fearless is an adult visual novel based on revenge. Set in a medieval world filled with magic and monsters, there's no telling what'll happen. The main character, Lare is a soldier with one huge flaw, he can't feel fear. This creates problems for him throughout the story. Should he get back at everyone who wronged him? Or should he let it go and move on?

[From [url=https://lar3games.itch.io/scared-fearless]Itch.io[/url]]
